adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is initialized as `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). Immediately after, for collective team events, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);`. If it’s `null`, the optional chaining prevents the push, so collected team members’ destination calendars are silently dropped, matching the finding.
